verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee is an API-first product. Its public documentation covers API-key authentication, many HTML API parameters, JS scenarios, AI extraction and proxy mode. It also documents dedicated APIs for Google, Amazon, Walmart, YouTube, ChatGPT, Gemini and usage, published as LLM-friendly llms.txt files. Community comments confirm developers build on it via API. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths 404), and hands-on corroboration that the documented endpoints behave as described.
